test_item_verbatim: Edit the name of the selected camera

tcs.tc_title: the R1 Low AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. The head unit is an R1 Low head unit
3. Only wired AUX cameras are fitted
4. No wireless AUX feature is offered
5. A wired AUX camera is connected
6. The individual AUX Cam settings pop-up is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the pop-up and check that "Edit Name" is offered
2. Select "Edit Name"
3. Read the HU display and check that a full QWERTY keyboard is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. "Edit Name" is shown in the pop-up
2. "Edit Name" registers the selection
3. A full QWERTY keyboard is displayed for editing the camera name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: the R1 Low AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera
tcs.test_item:
Edit the name of the selected camera

(the R1 Low AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera)

reasoning: §34.9.2 之父句逐字為 `From this pop-up the user can:`（`NRL-188187`），本列為其第一項。控制項之 label 取 §34.9.4 之 `“Edit Favorite”` 同節形制與 §31.1.1 之 `“Edit Name”`。與 `-129`／`-135`（§29.1.2／§29.2.2 之同名項）之分工：本列為 **R1 Low** 側之彈窗，其項目集只有兩項（§34.9.2.1／§34.9.2.2），無 favorite／delete。§34 之章標題逐字為 `R1 Low Wired AUX Cameras`（`NRL-188152`）；HU 等級**無 PROXI 編碼**（六串六本各 0 命中，CAM-17 證據 5），依 **DECISIONS 6-64** 不以此判車型，前提以散文書寫。
